description: Best swap quote on an EVM chain. Chord's own router answers first; another aggregator only when Chord cannot route. Amounts are integer strings in the token's smallest unit; the zero address is the native asset. Returns a quoteId valid for 2 minutes.

amount.description: Input amount in the smallest unit, digits only.

chain.description: EVM chain key. Solana swaps are REST only: GET /v1/sol/trade/quote.

taker.description: Optional: the wallet that will sign. With it the answer includes the transaction and a simulation.

tokenIn.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

tokenOut.description: Token address: 0x… on EVM chains, the base58 mint on Solana (case-sensitive).

name: chord_quote
title: Swap quote
